notes.title: Update 0.40
notes.notes:
This update bring a few more things to The Experiment

[h2]The Green Variant[/h2]
- There is no longer just 1 variant of The Experiment. Introducing the green variant. This little guy is smaller but don't let it's size fool you. While it is both slower and has worse eye sight, the lightweight aspect make it deadly with very faint footsteps. 
- There is also a unique death animation for this variant.
- Chance to encounter increases based on difficulty
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/2b7014bf2977f5f3839867554c86f19863d91b81.png[/img]

[h2]Outfits[/h2]
- More outfits are here! The color count has increased from 3 to 6. The 3 new colors include Blue, Purple and White.
- The previous outfit menu design was getting cluttered. The new design has the options above the preview and the buttons are now more minimal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/612f1ce2bf673601b16dd015333861b96e453efd.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
- The player cap has been increased to 8 players. The new outfits/gender combinations should help to differentiate players from one another. Please report any bugs if you find any glitches involving 8 players.
- Can now join via presence on Steam

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
There are other small minor changes and bug fixes.
- Menu now double checks if it's on players screen
- You can submit multiple bugs without having to load into a different map
- Dying in single player would cut the jump scare short
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Progress Update 2
notes.notes:
It has been over a week since the first progress update and steady progress has been made since then.

Here is a breakdown on how much of the game has been completed.

[h2]Gameplay - 80%[/h2]
The Gameplay includes things like, the enemy, x-ray machine, batteries, sanity etc.

[h1]OLD[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/602b8ee06366ce70c91fc8065b1cf6b5e305865c.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/edbf134d157502bab4c0fe20367e932df939b5ec.png[/img]

[h2]Maps - 30% Partially Complete[/h2]
Only 3 maps have been created: Main Menu, Lobby, and Silver Pine hospital. Only 1 gameplay map has been created as I have mainly been working on the gameplay. Once the game works with 1 map, I can create more maps.

[h1]OLD[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/faf7aa725a992d69da75cceb9a820cb7f901d541.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW[/h1] *Work in progress*
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/c6e64964f0bfb7053c79fbcc096763ad9d6aeb88.png[/img]

[h2]Lobby - 90% Almost Complete[/h2]
The lobby has had a full rework. It now features many interactable objects such as the Monitor, Mirror and more. This change was to make the lobby a bit more entertaining for ALL players.

[h1]OLD[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/a19cabfb55f804b55d9af5907778f10be41c4fc3.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/e52659cee06be5844bf0c63c170e13f14ff61f55.png[/img]

[h2]Cosmetics - 20% Early Development[/h2]
Cosmetics... WHY ? Hear me out, all the cosmetics in the game are free. All cosmetics are unlocked by just playing games. These cosmetics are only for your characters flashlight and allow customizability.

There is also now a way for players to customize their character. You can select gender and also color of your outfit.



The game itself is about 40-50% complete. This number is not factual as a lot of time will be spent fixing bugs, playtesting, making maps etc. I have been working on the game every day and I hope to release the game as soon as possible. Thanks for your patience :)

notes.title: The Audio Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Audio Update[/h1]
You have been asking for it and here it is.

[h2]Proximity Chat[/h2]
Players now have the option to use the in game voice proximity chat. It is recommended that all players use this for a more immersive experience. Look at the in game settings for more details and how to set it up. Make sure to setup key binds for these actions.

[h2]Audio Overhaul[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/7a117aeb02bc60089c2024f740c7443c5a4a8194.png[/img]
New sounds have been added. Here are a few examples:
-Soft groan from the experiment
-Heartbeat if you are very close to the experiment
-Ambient background audio
-Most sounds are now in 3D space and can be heard by nearby players

[h2]Revamped Lobby[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/c2d9312ee7ee02669c858c2567d8a37ab4c2273e.png[/img]
Some players found it difficult to start game and invite players. The keys have been removed and replaced by a monitor. This monitor can be used by the host to start game and invite players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/74eab11cbb81f6fa2ee6d27471c7e27748c29b59.png[/img]

[h3]Smaller Things[/h3]
[b]Added[/b]
Added feedback when clicking a lobby from the list of public games
Added a clock in each level for ambience
Added a way to leave text chat box by clicking on screen
Added editable text to all whiteboards by using text chat next to them

[b]Changed[/b]
Changed blend between standing and crouching to be smoother
Changed so all scroll boxes now lerp while scrolling
Changed font of "Quit To Desktop" to match the others
Changed player movement to be more snappy

[b]Fixed[/b]
Fixed crosshair not appearing on clients
Fixed The Experiment not respawning after being trapped in a room for 6.02s
Fixed an issue where the players would get stuck under the stretcher beds in the lobby
Fixed flickering on some whiteboards

[b]Removed[/b]
Removed the "Online Steam Friends" button from the main menu

notes.title: The Experiment Update 1.6
notes.notes:
[b]WOW[/b] ! It's only been 1 week since the game has officially launched and I am releasing another update. The game will still be receiving regular updates so please leave feedback.
I am currently working on some more minor optimisations and a new map for another update. For now though, this is the current update.

[h2]Added:[/h2]
Let's welcome another zombie to the mix. (More will be coming in future updates)
This is the white coloured zombie, it is very quick but can be heard from further away. You will need to keep your ears open more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/d7908c50810f968a5372ced902ac07284593d64c.png[/img]


The Lobby felt kind of restrictive compared to the regular hospitals. Now there is some space to explore while in the lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/74c7562bbeb9fd2bf8feaf405fce13e8d5baee02.png[/img]

[h2]Changed:[/h2]
The Sanity, Energy and Battery have all now been built into the image more. This is to try and have as little UI on the screen as possible as it can take away from the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/b4ec51a477f0f4518cd05a5591cb1c151bc7936b.png[/img]

The jump scares have been drastically changed. The old scares were too bright, glossy and just had the zombie punching you. The new scares have the zombie jump up at you and grab your face.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/1bd5187451cb0e1b9d744c02a40eab23a6021298.png[/img]

The UI has seen some small changes by making all the buttons the same size to make it the same as all the other menus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/47438aeced91428691e5c3fd2bd5ccfb9de2875a.png[/img]

With these new UI changes also come some animations for the animations fading in and out. For example, when collecting a key card, it will slide onto the screen instead of just appearing.

With 3 different zombies in the mix (and more on the way) it is best to get rid of the 85/15 spawn ratio and just go with even odds. The spawn rates will be even for all zombies going forward so keep an eye out for their colour.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336687/42b62ad74b8855fe4fcb686f69e23e789e89e20e.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
I know you aren't going to read this long list so I will make it quick:

Launch options for people who have had lighting issues
Z fighting fixed on corners of the map
Timer at end of the game displays in M:S.sss instead of just S.sss
Changing key bind for "Open Chat" now works properly
Tutorial now shows your key binds instead of the default
Tutorial lighting has been built
Sensitivity and Audio were sometimes not saving
Couch collision fixed
Thanks for reading :)

notes.title: The Halloween Update

Just a small update for the spooky season !

- Changed lights from a cooler blue colour to more of a warm orange colour (for halloween)
- Added 3 pumpkins in the lobby and in each of the 5 main hospitals (they serve no purpose but have fun finding them)
- Added back the original Silver Pine Hospital (before the map overhaul update). The map can only be played by stepping on the milk carton in the secret level.

notes.title: Update 1.38 (small changes)
notes.notes:
There has been some changes in the lighting system to improve the optimization of the game. HD Shadows are now OFF by default and there is now a "Recommended" graphics pre-set (which I highly suggest for the best experience). Depending on how this change is perceived, it may be reverted in the near future.

>Fixed some lighting issues
>Optimization improvement
>Very minor bug fixes



Thank you for your patience as I am still actively working on the game by myself.

If you find any bugs or want to suggest something, you can contact me here:
gr_productions@hotmail.com
